title: Senior Director AI/ML Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

An SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is a senior technology executive responsible for leading enterprise AI initiatives from strategy through execution and value realization. The role provides leadership for AI engineering organizations and serves as the accountable owner for AI platforms, intelligent automation capabilities, machine learning solutions, and emerging AI technologies that support business transformation. The position focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes through AI while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and governance.

The Senior Director is responsible for setting the technical and business direction for AI programs, establishing multi-year roadmaps, prioritizing investments, and aligning technology execution with organizational goals. They work closely with business leaders, product teams, operations partners, architecture groups, and executive leadership to identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, reduce cost, enhance customer experiences, and create new capabilities. Success is measured not only by technology delivery but also by adoption, operational impact, productivity gains, and financial value creation.

As a people leader, the role oversees a team of engineering leaders, AI engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, and platform specialists distributed across onshore and offshore locations. Responsibilities include organizational design, talent strategy, workforce planning, hiring, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning. The Senior Director creates an environment of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and engineering excellence while building a solid leadership bench capable of scaling enterprise AI capabilities.

From a technology perspective, this leader owns the end-to-end lifecycle of AI solutions, including platform architecture, model deployment, intelligent agents, automation frameworks, cloud infrastructure, production operations, observability, and reliability engineering. The role ensures that AI capabilities are developed as reusable enterprise assets rather than isolated solutions, enabling faster adoption and greater return on investment across multiple business domains.

The position carries significant accountability for Responsible AI, compliance, security, and risk management. The Senior Director ensures that all AI solutions comply with governance requirements, regulatory obligations, ethical AI principles, privacy standards, and operational controls. They establish processes for model monitoring, performance measurement, incident management, human oversight, and continuous improvement to maintain trust and reliability at enterprise scale.

The role requires solid executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders across the organization. The Senior Director regularly communicates strategy, progress, risks, investment needs, and business outcomes to executives while building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. They act as the bridge between technology and business organizations, ensuring that AI investments are translated into meaningful operational and financial results.

Ultimately, an SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is expected to provide broad organizational leadership, own enterprise-scale AI platforms and programs, drive adoption and value realization, build high-performing teams, ensure governance and operational excellence, and serve as the accountable leader for delivering transformative AI capabilities that advance the organization's strategic objectives.

**Primary Responsibility:**

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical field
* 15+ years of technology and software engineering experience, including at least 8-10 years of leadership experience managing engineering organizations
* Experience leading enterprise-scale AI platforms, MLOps, AI governance frameworks, model deployment, observability, and production operations
* Experience developing senior leaders, driving organizational transformation, managing talent strategies, workforce planning, succession planning, and building high-performing engineering cultures
* Experience translating business strategy into technology roadmaps and investment priorities
* Experience establishing and operating AI governance frameworks, Responsible AI practices, model risk management processes, security controls, compliance requirements, and audit readiness
* Experience partnering with CIOs, business executives, product leaders, operations leaders, and external partners
* Solid understanding of financial management, budgeting, business case development, operational metrics, and technology investment governance.
* Deep understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Natural Language Processing, Generative AI, intelligent automation, cloud platforms, and modern software engineering practices
* Proven track record of building and scaling enterprise AI/ML solutions, leading large engineering teams, and delivering measurable business outcomes through AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives
* Demonstrated success leading multi-functional teams across onshore and offshore locations
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* Proven ability to manage complex portfolios, prioritize competing demands, drive value realization, and communicate effectively with executive leadership
* Demonstrated ability to present strategy, roadmap, business value, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and executive committees
* Demonstrated ability to inspire teams while maintaining solid accountability for execution and results
* Demonstrated ability to balance innovation with enterprise governance, regulatory obligations, privacy requirements, and operational risk management

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering Management, or Business Administration
* Ph.D. in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related discipline is advantageous for highly specialized AI leadership roles
* Industry certifications such as Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, SAFe Agilist, PMP, TOGAF, Certified Scrum Professional, or other AI, cloud, architecture, and leadership certifications
* Solid knowledge of Azure AI services, APIs, distributed systems, and platform engineering

**Key Competencies**

Strategic thinking, enterprise leadership, AI innovation, platform ownership, product mindset, organizational design, talent development, executive communication, stakeholder influence, financial stewardship, operational excellence, governance leadership, and business outcome accountability.

**Ideal SG31 Profile**

An executive-level AI leader who can build and scale enterprise AI platforms, lead large engineering organizations, influence senior leadership, govern AI responsibly, and deliver measurable business value through adoption, automation, productivity improvements, cost savings, and transformational AI capabilities.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Global BI&A Product Director - Commercial
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

BCG's Global Business Intelligence & Analytics team builds the analytics products BCG's own
  
leadership uses to run the firm — monitoring performance, shaping commercial strategy,
  
allocating investment, and steering leadership initiatives. Your customers are internal: regional
  
and global function leaders, up to and including BCG's most senior executives.  
As a Product and Delivery Owner, you will own a portfolio of Commercial performancemanagement products end to end — from raw data through to the reporting interface — and
  
lead the cross-functional squad that builds them. You will set priorities with your BI&A Business
  
Partners, manage a demanding senior stakeholder pipeline, and make trade-offs between
  
customer value, cost, and speed of delivery clear and transparent for our stakeholders

* Own end-to-end product delivery for BI&A’s Commercial Product Portfolio — Starting

from non-conformed source data through ETL layer to the reporting UI — holding the  
bar high on architecture quality, data quality, performance, and user experience  

* Set and manage the roadmap with your BI&A Business Partners, maintaining a

transparent, prioritized backlog where trade-offs are explicit and understood by
  
stakeholders  

* Partner with executive stakeholders across regions and global functions to define a

coherent suite of Commercial management products — eliciting requirements,
  
facilitating design trade-offs, and setting clear delivery timelines and acceptance criteria  

* Lead your squad through the full Agile cadence — sprint planning and reviews,

quarterly and annual business reviews — translating Tribe objectives into concrete
  
sprint goals and KPIs, and unblocking the team as an escalation point  

* Manage resourcing and budget — directly line-managing your Functional Product

Analysts, working with Chapter Leads on technical resourcing, and running your Product  
portfolio's budget in collaboration with the Tribe Leadership  

* Raise your squad's AI fluency and output — set and maintain AI fluency standards

for the team. Build agents and tools that make both your squad and your internal
  
customers more effective and efficient  

* Drive adoption. You will champion stakeholder adoption across BCG and foster a

culture of data-driven decision making and continuous business improvement

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years in Product Owner, Product Manager, Delivery Lead, or a comparable

leadership role, including clear experience delivering enterprise BI products at scale  

* A track record of leading Agile teams, with deep command of Agile principles and

practice  

* Proven ability to lead a technology-enabled and enterprise-level Business, Digital or

Organizational transformation  

* Hands-on depth in front-end reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or SAP

BusinessObjects  

* Familiarity with data warehousing tools and concepts, including transformation logic

and end-to-end data flows  

* High AI fluency, both as a practitioner and as a leader introducing new ways of

working

Who You'll Work With

* Your Squad — as their leader and coach, you will create the conditions for the team

to do its best work  

* BI&A Business Partners — who manage BI&A's key internal relationships and

surface strategic business needs  

* Internal customers — Translating BCG executives and global function leader’s

voice and needs into actionable deliverables for our squad  

* Tribe Leaders — who will set the vision, roadmap, budget, and priorities & OKRs for

the tribes and subsequently, for the squads  

* Scrum Masters — who will help clear obstacles and support you with the Agile

artifacts and ceremonies  

* Fellow Product and Delivery Owners — to share best practices, contribute to a

cohesive culture and ensure alignment between squads  

* Agile Coaches — who, like you, are passionate about Agile ways of working and

with whom you will promote business agility, both within your teams and across the
  
organization

Additional info

"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Capability Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Data Product Capability Manager is a senior, hybrid role that combines the strategic focus of a data product owner with the cross-functional coordination responsibilities of a capability manager. This individual will own the definition, prioritization, and delivery of enterprise data capabilities - establishing the structure for how structured data is identified, governed, and consumed across the organization. Reporting into the Product Management organization, the role serves as the central connective tissue between business stakeholders, data domain owners, IT delivery, and data governance functions, ensuring that data products are developed in alignment with enterprise strategy, quality standards, and business value objectives.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Data Strategy Management & Roadmap Ownership: Define and maintain the enterprise data capability roadmap in alignment with overall business strategy. Identify data investment priorities, manage the capability backlog, and communicate progress and value delivery to senior stakeholders
* Vendor & Internal Data Needs Assessment: Evaluate and document structured data requirements across both vendor-sourced and internally generated datasets. Partner with procurement, legal, and data architecture teams to assess fit, feasibility, and compliance of data supply options
* Business & Domain Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with business and domain owners to identify and validate authoritative data sources (Systems of Truth / SOTs) and key attribute requirements. Facilitate workshops and working sessions to surface data needs, resolve conflicts, and build shared understanding of data definitions
* IT Partnership & Agile Delivery Planning: Collaborate with IT and engineering teams to translate data capability requirements into delivery plans using agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum). Participate in sprint planning, PI planning, and backlog grooming to ensure alignment between business priorities and technical execution
* Data Governance Support & Stewardship: Support and actively contribute to enterprise data governance frameworks, policies, and practices. Work with data stewards and governance councils to ensure data capabilities are developed and maintained in compliance with data standards, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations
* Data Quality Management: Define and enforce data quality standards, metrics, and SLAs for owned data products. Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to implement monitoring, remediation, and continuous improvement processes that ensure fitness-for-purpose data across the enterprise
* Data Product Definition & Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise data products - from ideation and requirements definition through development, launch, and sunset. Ensure data products are well-documented, discoverable, and aligned to measurable business outcomes
* Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation path for data capability delivery across business, IT, and governance functions. Manage stakeholder expectations, facilitate issue resolution, and deliver regular status updates and executive-level reporting
* Data Maturity & Capability Development: Assess the current state of enterprise data capabilities against industry benchmarks and organizational goals. Develop and execute maturity improvement plans that elevate the organization's ability to manage, consume, and derive value from data assets
* Metadata & Data Catalog Stewardship: Champion the adoption and maintenance of enterprise metadata standards and data catalog tools. Ensure critical data attributes, lineage, and ownership are documented and accessible to enable data discoverability and self-service analytics across the organization
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
* 9+ years of experience in product management, data management, or a related discipline, with demonstrated accountability for delivering data or technology capabilities in a complex enterprise environment
* Hands-on experience working in agile delivery environments; proficiency with agile frameworks such as Scrum, and familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent
* Experience supporting or leading data governance initiatives, including data quality programs, data stewardship models, or regulatory compliance efforts (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
* Solid understanding of structured data concepts including data modeling, data dictionaries, systems of record/truth, master data management, and enterprise data architecture principles
* Proven ability to elicit, document, and prioritize data requirements from business and domain stakeholders, including the ability to reconcile conflicting priorities and drive alignment
* Proven exceptional cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across business, IT, and executive audiences

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant certifications such as CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), SAFe Product Owner/Manager, or equivalent data or agile credentials
* Experience with vendor evaluation and management, including RFI/RFP processes for data and technology solutions
* Experience on US Healthcare Domain
* Experience in a capability management, product ownership, or enterprise program management role within a data & analytics, enterprise architecture, or digital transformation context
* Familiarity with data catalog and metadata management tools such as Alation, Collibra, Informatica, or Microsoft Purview
* Understanding of cloud data platform ecosystems (e.g., Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) and their implications for data product design and delivery

title: Release Train Engineer
description:
About This Role
**5 years of experience**  

**Skills: SAFe 5, RTE, PI Planning, ART Sync, Stakeholder Engagement, Agile, Banking, Capital Markets, DevOps, Jira/confluence**

**About the Role** We are looking for an experienced Release Train Engineer (RTE) with 5\+ years of experience to lead and facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) delivery You will serve as a servant leader and coach for the ART — facilitating PI Planning, managing cross\-team dependencies, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement across the delivery organisation. Banking and capital markets domain experience is essential for this role — enabling you to engage credibly with business stakeholders, understand regulatory delivery constraints, and navigate the governance frameworks of a complex financial services environment.


**Key Responsibilities**


ART Facilitation \& Delivery


* Facilitate and coordinate all ART\-level ceremonies — PI Planning, ART Sync, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops — ensuring effective cross\-team alignment and programme increment delivery.
* Manage and coordinate delivery across two squads of 7 — ensuring teams are aligned to PI objectives, dependencies are managed, and risks are identified and mitigated proactively.
* Track and manage ART\-level programme board — maintaining visibility of features, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both squads throughout each programme increment.
* Facilitate cross\-team dependency resolution — identifying blockers, coordinating between squads, and escalating impediments that cannot be resolved at team level.
* Support squad\-level Scrum Masters — providing coaching, guidance, and facilitation support to ensure effective Agile ceremonies and team delivery rhythms.
* Monitor and report ART\-level delivery metrics — velocity, predictability, feature completion, and PI objective achievement — providing clear, evidence\-based progress updates to programme leadership.
* Coordinate System Demo preparation and execution — ensuring both squads deliver integrated, demonstrable working software at the end of each programme increment.

Continuous Improvement \& Coaching


* Lead Inspect \& Adapt workshops — facilitating structured retrospectives at ART level, identifying systemic improvement opportunities, and driving measurable delivery improvement.
* Coach squads, Product Owners, and stakeholders on SAFe principles, Agile practices, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Champion DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving build, test, and deployment automation to accelerate feature delivery.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and psychological safety across both squads — enabling high\-performing, self\-organising teams.

Stakeholder Management \& Governance


* Act as the primary ART\-level communication interface — providing regular, clear delivery status updates to programme managers, product leadership, and senior stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with Business Owners, Product Management, and key stakeholders — facilitating business engagement in PI Planning, System Demos, and governance forums.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level planning — providing ART capacity, dependency, and risk inputs to support programme and portfolio prioritisation decisions.
* Support risk and compliance governance — ensuring ART delivery activities align to organisational delivery standards, change management processes, and regulatory requirements within a banking and capital markets environment.
* Maintain ART\-level documentation — PI plans, programme boards, risk registers, and retrospective action logs.

**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of experience in Agile delivery roles — Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach — with at least 2–3 years as a Release Train Engineer in a SAFe environment.


* Deep SAFe expertise — PI Planning facilitation, ART coordination, programme board management, and Inspect \& Adapt — with proven ability to lead ARTs of 10–15\+ people.


* **Banking and capital markets domain experience — essential** — understanding of financial services delivery constraints, regulatory governance, and capital markets technology programmes.


* Experience managing cross\-team dependencies and delivery coordination across multiple squads in fast\-paced programme delivery environments.


* Strong servant leadership and coaching skills — supporting Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and squad members in Agile best practices.


* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — engaging senior business and technology stakeholders with clear, concise ART\-level delivery reporting.


* Proficiency with Agile tooling — Jira, Confluence, Miro — for PI planning, programme board management, and delivery reporting.


* Strong facilitation skills — leading large\-group PI Planning events, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops with energy, structure, and impact.


* Good understanding of DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving automation and deployment frequency.


* Strong analytical mindset — interpreting ART delivery metrics and driving data\-informed continuous improvement.


**Nice to Have**


* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification — SAFe 5 or SAFe 6\.
* SAFe Programme Consultant (SPC) certification.
* Experience in capital markets technology programmes — trade reporting, regulatory platforms, market data, or trading systems delivery.
* Familiarity with LPM (Lean Portfolio Management) and portfolio\-level Agile governance.
* Experience with scaled Agile tooling — Jira Align, Rally, or equivalent ART\-level planning tools.
* Agile coaching certification — ICP\-ACC or equivalent.
* Exposure to regulatory delivery programmes — MiFID II, EMIR, APRA, or equivalent financial services regulatory change.
